criteria.requirement: Add Table.find _columns=None|string|sequence and forward through real find_one. Build an actual SQLAlchemy select of requested columns in order, preserving filters, hidden sort keys, offset/limit, streaming and configured row_type. Default full rows remain identical. Normalize through existing column naming, reject empty/duplicate/unknown projections, safely quote spaces and never interpolate SQL. No-match and nonexistent-table behavior remains empty/None without creating a table. Prove omitted fields are absent from both streamed and find_one results.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
